steps.share: Tap the Share button in Safari's toolbar.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: When you sign in with Google we receive your name, email address and profile photo. Everything else is what you add: events, wishlists with their photos, exclusion rules and chat messages. If you turn on notifications, we store your device's push subscription.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Only to run your gift exchanges: showing events and wishlists to their participants, running the draw, delivering messages and sending the notifications you chose. We don't sell your data or show ads.

visibility.title: Who sees what
visibility.body: Participants of an event see its wishlists and each other's names. Only you can see whom you give to; not even the host can. If you start an anonymous chat, the other person only ever sees a "Secret Elf" number.

storage.title: Where it is stored
storage.body: Data is kept on our servers and photos in private cloud storage. Photos are stripped of location and other metadata when you upload them.

deletion.title: Deleting your data
deletion.body: You can delete your account from your Profile at any time, except while you're in an event that has been drawn. Deleting it erases your profile, wishlists, photos and devices, and empties the messages you sent.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about your data can be sent to the people who run this app. Contact details will be added in the final version.

use.title: Using Secret Santa
use.body: Secret Santa helps groups organize gift exchanges. You need a Google account to use it, and you're responsible for what you do with it.

content.title: Your content
content.body: You keep ownership of what you add. Only add photos and text you have the right to share, and be kind: anonymous chats are for gift hints, not for harassment.

events.title: Events and the draw
events.body: The host runs the event and triggers the draw. After the draw, no one can join or leave, and it can't be redrawn.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: The app is offered as is, without guarantees that it will always be available or free of errors. Notifications depend on your browser and device.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: These terms may change. We'll update this page when they do.
